concerns.text: The data model lists three primary entities (PhysicsTrajectory, VideoSequence, EvaluationResults) but only provides schemas for PhysicsTrajectory and EvaluationResults. No schema/contract is defined for VideoSequence, yet the plan (e.g., T1.2) creates and uses VideoSequence objects. Add a `video_sequence.schema.yaml` contract and reference it in the plan to keep the data model and contracts consistent.
